title: One NZ Pivots from Traditional Oracle Support to Fuel AI Ambitions with Rimini Street
summary: New Zealand telecommunications powerhouse One NZ is making a significant strategic shift, enlisting Rimini Street for specialized third-party support of its extensive Oracle software estate. This move aims to both future-proof its critical enterprise systems and liberate resources, allowing the company to accelerate its focus on cutting-edge artificial intelligence innovation.
content:
Auckland, New Zealand – In a bold move signaling a fresh strategic direction, One NZ, a leading telecommunications provider, has announced a partnership with Rimini Street, the global provider of enterprise software products and services. The core of this collaboration sees One NZ transitioning away from traditional vendor support for its vast Oracle software landscape, opting instead for Rimini Street’s renowned third-party support services. This pivot is more than just a change in service provider; it's a calculated effort to optimize operations and ignite a new era of AI-driven innovation.

For years, enterprises globally have grappled with the often-inflexible and costly nature of legacy software vendor support. One NZ’s decision highlights a growing trend among tech-forward companies seeking greater agility and value. By entrusting its Oracle estate to Rimini Street, One NZ gains access to a more responsive, tailored support model, often at a significantly reduced cost compared to original equipment manufacturer (OEM) agreements. This immediate financial and operational efficiency is critical for reinvesting into strategic growth areas.

Rimini Street, known for its expertise in third-party support for giants like Oracle and SAP, brings more than just maintenance to the table. As an "Agentic AI ERP Company," they are uniquely positioned to help clients like One NZ not only stabilize their existing core systems but also explore how AI can be integrated and optimized within their enterprise resource planning (ERP) environment. This holistic approach ensures that One NZ’s foundational technology remains robust while simultaneously laying the groundwork for advanced AI capabilities.

This strategic alignment empowers One NZ to future-proof its essential Oracle applications, ensuring their longevity and performance without being beholden to forced upgrades or sunsets. Crucially, the bandwidth and budget freed up through this partnership will be directly funneled into One NZ’s ambitious AI initiatives. It’s a clear signal that the company is serious about leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance customer experience, streamline internal processes, and unlock new service offerings in the competitive telecom sector.

The partnership underscores a broader industry shift where innovation is increasingly driven by strategic resource allocation and a willingness to challenge traditional vendor relationships. One NZ’s proactive step with Rimini Street positions it to not only maintain a robust IT backbone but also accelerate its journey toward becoming a truly AI-first enterprise.
keyTakeaways: One NZ is shifting from traditional Oracle vendor support to Rimini Street's third-party services.
The move aims to optimize costs and gain more flexible, tailored support for its Oracle systems.
This strategic partnership will free up resources, allowing One NZ to accelerate its focus on AI innovation across its operations.
author: Rutuparna Rath
